description: This file provides Danish translations for the Select2 jQuery plugin, version 4.0.6-rc.1. It defines localized error messages and interface strings for Danish users.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the Danish string for 'Results could not be loaded.'

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a Danish message indicating how many characters should be removed.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a Danish message indicating how many more characters are needed.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the Danish loading more results message.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a Danish message indicating the maximum number of selections allowed.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the Danish message when no search results are found.
